content: Caddy on_demand_tls uses a GET ask endpoint (e.g. GET /ask?domain=x) queried before every first handshake for a new hostname; 2xx=allow, anything else=deny, redirects not followed, endpoint must be internal-only and respond in a few ms (it is on the TLS handshake critical path) via constant-time DB lookup. Deprecated: interval/burst rate-limit options — replaced by the 'permission' module. Without an ask endpoint this is a DoS/Let's-Encrypt-rate-limit vector.
